reuse_decision.renderRuns: Native bitmap atlas, optical4x and fixed metrics cannot express contextual TrueType shaping/hinting. Adding fontbackend mode would mix unrelated design decisions. Preserve existing pipeline.
reuse_decision.composeCells: Reuse composition when coverage exists; does not own font parsing/shaping.
reuse_decision.manifestTextures: Retains grouping/order/page/link/publication; not an appropriate native font engine owner.
reuse_decision.new_boundary: One textMasks function: pinned font bytes+size+layout+label list -> Gray masks/bearings/advances. No per-font/script helper functions; C API directly through cgo, no new C function.
reuse_decision.test_owner: Existing TestPilotHistoricalGoldenBytes body enhanced in isolated harness; keep same existing test function, no new test function/closure.

scope: Only owned /var/tmp prototype and this decision/state; production unchanged
Installed FreeType+Raqm runtime linked with pinned public header; no installs
No Python runtime bridge, hostfont search, per-label assets or Unicode narrowing
Before production design must pass original vectors and build/runtime portability assessment
sources: frozen Pillow12.3 _imagingft.c + Raqm/HB source in verified private pack
limitations: Prototype feasibility only, no migration credit, production integration, current-mod or gameplay proof.
